title: PR 32433 - Protect settings edits during Save
summary: Flow: user edits A, saves A, then types B while A is pending. Problem: the older response can close the editor and overwrite B. Fix direction: track form versions and preserve unsaved edits. Review focus: every caller must honor false and every dirty editor must resist stale context refresh.
